notes.title: DEMO UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42009724/62fd15407314bb1f8ce1d56bec7967b1b10b47e2.gif[/img]



[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] The Void Seeker now has a new attack and his phase 2 has been reworked/rebalanced
[*] Gamma option added
[*] Contrast option added
[*] Option to remove Black outlines
[*] Server list now displays game progress
[*] Camera Zoom value is now saved
[*] You can now dash to break pots
[*] Added Active Ability description to the Inspect Menu
[*] Added separated values for X and Y camera sensitivity
[*] Effect chance and alteration stats are now displayed when modifying a weapon
[*] Option to reset Keybind controls
[*] Option to swap to certain weapons directly
[*] and more
[/list]

[h2]Bug fix[/h2]

[list]
[*] Void Gather FX and SFX not removing correctly on clients
[*] Loop machine would sometimes appear at the wrong place on clients
[*] Game Art would stretch on wide monitors
[*] Quests could be progressed in the Lobby
[*] Players could finish a revive while dying
[*] Impact modifier would sometimes have a X1 Damage
[*] Camera issue that would not be the same sensitivity on the X and Y axis
[*] Some map generation on the second level would sometimes have decor elements in the way
[*] Enduring mind would play sounds of taking hits when health would deplete from Overhealth or the Bloodfang
[*] The Void Seeker would sometimes appear at the center of the arena in Phase 2
[*] Chat would not scroll all the way down when typing a long message
[*] Several other small fixes on the Void Seeker
[*] and more...
[/list]

notes.title: DEMO - New Suit THE REDEMPTOR + bug fix, balance
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42009724/c8f1044c00d8439c69d9defe8bffc73aa9c8e848.png[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] New Suit : [b]THE REDEMPTOR[/b]

This suit is designed with melee and close quarters players in mind. Dash straight through enemies with a unique devastating dash.
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]

[list]
[*] Ammo Drop are more frequent across all difficulties
[*] Crystal Drop are more frequent for the Explorer difficulty
[*] Prism Drop are more frequent across all difficulties
[*] Ajusted the SFX of the anomaly canon to be more consistent with the rest of the sounds
[*] All flying enemies have been increased in size and added some emissive parts to make them easier to see.
[/list]


[h3]Bug fix[/h3]

[list]
[*] Players joining a game late would sometimes have decor elements still present (they would see huge rocks in the middle of levels)
[*] If a player took a long time to load, other players would be free to move before the map would generate
[*] Sometimes Anomally projectiles would not disappear
[*] Steam VR would open for no reason
[*] Medic Quest would not track
[*] Guns and Go in Lobby had a collider that would cause the player to hear the landing SFX repeating very rapidly
[/list]

notes.title: NEW DEMO AND KICKSTARTER ON THE 29TH!
notes.content:
[h1]The DEMO[/h1]
The demo will contain a preview of the first 2 levels of the game and allow player access to
more than [b]18 abilities[/b] to create their own loadouts. 
Players can expect up to [b]10 hours[/b] of content to unlock everything. 

Dowload the [b]Demo now[/b] Directly on Steam

[h1]KICKSTARTER[/h1]
Simultaneously, the studio announces the launch of a [b]Kickstarter campaign[/b] to support the final stages of development to add extra content and an extra layer of polish.

Players who back "[b]The Raider[/b]" tier or more on kickstarter can unlock [b]immediate [/b]access to the current [b]full version[/b] of the game.

Support the Campaign [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/honestdemon/the-last-citadel-a-true-coop-rogue-lite]HERE[/url]
